channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: 'A goodness that never ends': Amyza Aznan reflects on late son's lasting legacy of kindness
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Actress Amyza Aznan has shared a deeply emotional tribute to her late son, Andre Mikhail, describing him as a devoted and righteous child whose kindness continued even after his passing.

item.title: Restaurant owner fined RM2k for killing stray dog with firecracker
item.description: BATU GAJAH: A restaurant owner was fined RM2,000 by the magistrate’s court here today after pleading guilty to committing mischief by killing a stray dog using a firecracker in January.

item.title: Report alleges prominent family sought UK firm's help to pressure PM
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A prominent family with assets worth billions of ringgit allegedly engaged a London-based firm to pressure Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim and Tan Sri Azam Baki.

item.title: UTM respects legal process as instructors charged with cadet's death
item.description: JOHOR BARU: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM) said it respects the legal process and remains committed to transparency following the charging of three Reserve Officer Training Unit (Palapes) instructors over the death of a cadet.

item.title: Yellow bamboo lamps revive Ramadan, Syawal nostalgia
item.description: BUKIT KAYU HITAM: The uniqueness of yellow bamboo oil lamps, which are becoming increasingly rare, has made them a sought-after item again as two brothers-in-law from Kampung Felda Batu Lapan Luar here struggle to keep up with orders ahead of Ramadan and Aidilfitri.

item.title: CIMB Q4 net profit up 6.6pct on stronger operations, declares record dividend
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: CIMB Group Holdings Bhd, Malaysia’s second-largest bank, recorded a 6.62 per cent rise in net profit for the fourth quarter ended Dec 31, 2025, supported by stronger operating income.

item.title: Malaysian weightlifters target 4 golds at Glasgow Commonwealth Games
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Malaysian Weightlifting Federation (MWF) has set a four-gold target for the 2026 Glasgow Commonwealth Games from July 23-Aug 2.

item.title: [UPDATED] Anwar: Govt deliberates on RCI proposal over MACC allegations
item.description: KAJANG: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim assured that the government had deliberated on calls for a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI) to investigate allegations of a corporate mafia involving the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC).

item.title: Hadi denies being dictatorial over opposition leader post
item.description: MARANG: Pas president Tan Sri Abdul Hadi Awang has denied being dictatorial in determining the appointment of the opposition leader in parliament.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: 'Our family is growing': Intan Najuwa expecting second child
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Popular actress Intan Najuwa has taken to social media to share the joyous news that she is expecting her second child.
